examples.text: Спера́нский приласка́л дочь свое́ю бе́лою руко́й, и поцелова́л её. И э́тот жест показа́лся неесте́ственным кня́зю Андре́ю.
examples.translation: He patted the little girl with his white hand and kissed her. And that gesture, too, seemed unnatural to Prince Andrew.
examples.english: He patted the little girl with his white hand and kissed her. And that gesture, too, seemed unnatural to Prince Andrew.

translations.source_sense_description: не свойственный природе, естественному порядку вещей

glosses: Not occurring in nature, the environment or atmosphere

examples.text: Time wore heavily on with Winnie Santon, after Natalie had left them. Left as she was, much in her unnatural mother's society, who seemed to be never more pleased than when she might thwart her designs, or, in some manner act so as to make those about her uncomfortable, it was not to be wondered at, if she did sigh for other days, and a confidant, to whom she might unburden her heart.
One mother, when she heard that her daughter intended to take up medicine, retired to her room and wept, bewailing the fact that she had given birth to an "unnatural daughter."

glosses: One who is unnatural, against nature, perverse.

examples.text: In the so-called "golden era" of science fiction, gay/lesbian characters were treated as misfits, sociopaths, villains and "unnaturals" to be pitied and scorned. Gay characters were virtually all weak, effeminate snivelers out to harm the heroes of the story. Lesbians were invariably portrayed as massive, muscular Amazons with sadistic tendencies.
Deviants, heretics, pinks, false prophets and other unnaturals will not be spared the rod nor the stark fist of removal.
The affected products had to be recalled.
He spoke with an affected English accent.
The affected articulation of his opinions made it challenging to discern his true stance.
He drove over last Saturday with this English babe that’s in this new picture he’s writing. She was pretty affected, but very good-looking.

Jones […] was easily prevailed on to satisfy Mr Dowling's curiosity, by relating the history of his birth and education, which he did, like Othello. […] Mr Dowling was indeed very greatly affected with this relation; for he had not divested himself of humanity by being an attorney.
an affected equation

glosses: Resulting from a mostly negative physical effect or transformation.
Someone affected, as by a disease.

examples.text: Affecteds felt that they get conflicting orders from superiors more frequently than did nonaffecteds […]. Affecteds were more frequently bothered by feelings of a sharp increase in their workload than nonaffecteds […].

glosses: simple past and past participle of affect

examples.text: The thunderstorm affected the compass, and we got lost.

glosses: Not usual, out of the ordinary.

examples.text: Every once in a while, though, Idol comes across an unusual talent who just blows everyone away.
It’s definitely not unusual for a couple to meet through friends or be set up on a date.
His behavior was unusual in that it was considered childish for a man of his age.
I’ve had no problem with female docs. I’ve had some – how should I say it – unusual experiences with a couple of male ones. And I have heard from girlfriends about their unusual experiences as well.

glosses: Something that is unusual; an anomaly.

examples.text: I should say that it was very unusual for such men to leave a bottle half empty. How do all these unusuals strike you, Watson?
